notes: Event date: 3 April 1945, noon (Stacey, p. 529). current_activity: Operation Cannonshot: the 2nd Brigade crosses the Ijssel at 16:30 between Zutphen and Deventer; 1st Brigade next day
notes: Event date: 11 April 1945, 16:30 (Stacey, pp. 551-552). Event definition: The division launches Operation Cannonshot, its first operation in north-west Europe, with the 2nd Brigade crossing the Ijssel in Buffaloes of the 79th Armoured Division from 16:30, midway between Zutphen and Deventer, with Princess Patricia Canadian Light Infantry and The Seaforth Highlanders of Canada; on 12 April the 1st Brigade passes through to expand the bridgehead westward towards Apeldoorn. Event support: one source family (Stacey, the Canadian official history). notes: Event date: 13 April 1945 (Stacey, p. 573). Event definition: The division reverts to the command of General Foulkes from the 2nd Corps on 13 April while its brigades expand the Ijssel bridgehead towards Apeldoorn, the 2nd Brigade clearing the Hoven bridgehead opposite Zutphen.
